ndvi-vs-sentinel-vine-mapping.author: Sentinel Blog
ndvi-vs-sentinel-vine-mapping.title: Drone Mapping for Vineyards: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
ndvi-vs-sentinel-vine-mapping.content: NDVI drone mapping may generate colorful heatmaps, but it doesn’t give vineyard managers the actionable, historical insight needed to track disease or manage vines long term. Sentinel Vine Manager captures real vine-level data using smartphones and GNSS, preserving critical information year after year and transforming how vineyards make decisions.

xchateau-podcast.author: Robert Vernick & Peter Yeung
xchateau-podcast.title: A Medical Record for Each Vine w/ Shawn DeMartino, Sentinel
xchateau-podcast.content: After struggling with tracking vineyard data firsthand, Shawn DeMartino, CEO and Founder of Sentinel, decided to create a solution with his partner. Enabling vine by vine mapping and data collection that could stand the test of time enables vineyard managers to increase the lifespan of a vineyard, manage viruses, and effectively create a “medical record” for each individual vine.

inside-winemaking-podcast.author: Jim Duane
inside-winemaking-podcast.title: Exclusive Interview - Sentinel Founder Shawn DeMartino talks vineyard tech on the Inside Winemaking Podcast
inside-winemaking-podcast.content: In this episode, winemaker Shawn DeMartino shares his journey from Argentina to becoming a winemaker in Napa Valley. He discusses his experiences working with renowned mentors and the significance of hands-on learning in winemaking. Shawn also highlights his innovative work building the Sentinel Vine Manager app, a program leveraging high fidelity geospatial technology to monitor vineyard health and production. The episode explores the balance between tradition and innovation in winemaking and offers tips for managing vineyards of all sizes.

sentinels-technological-revolution-in-vi.author: James Bayley
sentinels-technological-revolution-in-vi.title: Harper's Wine and Spirits - Sentinel’s technological revolution in vineyards worldwide
sentinels-technological-revolution-in-vi.content: Sentinel Vine Manager is changing the way vineyards operate across the globe. The innovative tool, developed by Shawn DeMartino and Christian Sidak, is revolutionising vineyard management with precise, vine-by-vine data collection. This new approach is transforming vineyard operations, offering a more efficient and effective way to manage and maintain vineyards.

a-game-changing-new-vineyard-management-.author: Samantha Cole-Johnson
a-game-changing-new-vineyard-management-.title: SevenFifty Daily - A Game-Changing New Vineyard Management Technology
a-game-changing-new-vineyard-management-.content: A smartphone app called Sentinel Vine Manager generates revolutionary vineyard maps that track individual vine histories using Global Navigation Satellite Systems and cloud analytics.

the-red-blotch-dilemma.author: Sentinel Blog
the-red-blotch-dilemma.title: Redefining the Red Blotch Challenge: Navigating the Reality of Vineyard Management in Napa
the-red-blotch-dilemma.content: Napa Valley, renowned for its picturesque vineyards and world-class wines, is facing a challenge that is reshaping the landscape of viticulture. The Red Blotch problem has become a prevalent issue, and while many are diligently working to address it, there are misconceptions about the nature of the problem and how to effectively manage it.

why-excel-is-an-expensive-way-to-map-vir.author: Sentinel Blog
why-excel-is-an-expensive-way-to-map-vir.title: Why Spreadsheets are the Most Expensive Way to Map Virus
why-excel-is-an-expensive-way-to-map-vir.content: In the ever-evolving landscape of viticulture, the Red Blotch virus has presented a formidable challenge to Napa Valley's vineyards. The quest for an elusive zero-virus scenario is proving financially unattainable, with the costs of testing and replanting reaching unprecedented heights. Decision-makers are grappling with the intricacies of managing virus outbreaks, often resorting to traditional tools such as hand-drawn maps and Excel spreadsheets. However, what they may not realize is that these seemingly cost-effective methods are, in fact, the most expensive way to map a virus. In this exploration, we delve into the overlooked labor costs associated with these manual approaches, shedding light on why Sentinel's streamlined solution emerges as the more financially sustainable alternative for Napa's vineyards.

vine-data-during-a-downturn.author: Sentinel Blog
vine-data-during-a-downturn.title: The Downturn Is the Wrong Time to Stop Counting Your Vines
vine-data-during-a-downturn.content: When the California wine market tightens, vineyard monitoring is the first budget line to get cut. That instinct is backwards. In a downturn, vine-level data is worth more than ever -- because the margins no longer cover the cost of decisions made without it.

the-replant-decision.author: Sentinel Blog
the-replant-decision.title: The $80,000-Per-Acre Question: When to Replant
the-replant-decision.content: Replanting a Napa vineyard block costs $50,000 to $80,000 per acre in real terms. Most estates still make that decision by feel. Vine-level data turns a gut call into a precise, block-by-block analysis -- and reveals how often the answer is a partial replant instead of a full one.

the-knowledge-that-walks-out-the-door.author: Sentinel Blog
the-knowledge-that-walks-out-the-door.title: The Knowledge That Walks Out the Door
the-knowledge-that-walks-out-the-door.content: When your most experienced vineyard worker retires, decades of vine-level knowledge leaves with them. Which row always gets mildew first. Where the old virus pocket was. Which vines are on different rootstock. A permanent digital record is the only way to keep that knowledge inside your estate.

vineyard-management-software-buyers-guid.author: Sentinel Blog
vineyard-management-software-buyers-guid.title: Vineyard Management Software: The 2026 Buyer's Guide
vineyard-management-software-buyers-guid.content: If you manage a vineyard and you are evaluating software for the first time, or reconsidering what you already use, this guide is for you. The vineyard management software market has matured considerably over the past few years, but it has also become harder to navigate.

vine-level-disease-tracking-program.author: Sentinel Blog
vine-level-disease-tracking-program.title: How to Build a Vine-Level Disease Tracking Program
vine-level-disease-tracking-program.content: Every vineyard has disease. Red blotch, leafroll, crown gall, Esca -- the specific pathogen varies by region, but the management challenge is universal. The vineyards that contain disease effectively are the ones that know exactly where every infected vine is.

rtk-gps-vineyard-guide.author: Sentinel Blog
rtk-gps-vineyard-guide.title: RTK GPS for Vineyards: Why Sub-Inch Accuracy Changes Everything
rtk-gps-vineyard-guide.content: If you manage a vineyard and have started looking into GPS mapping, you have probably noticed that the technology landscape is confusing. This guide covers everything a vineyard manager needs to know about RTK GPS.

drone-vineyard-mapping-vs-ground-truth.author: Sentinel Blog
drone-vineyard-mapping-vs-ground-truth.title: Drone Mapping vs. Ground-Truth Scouting: What Your Vineyard Actually Needs
drone-vineyard-mapping-vs-ground-truth.content: Drone vineyard mapping gives you a canopy heatmap. Ground-truth scouting gives you vine-by-vine records. This post breaks down when you need each, where they overlap, and why the best operations use both.

cellar-management-software-winery-guide.author: Sentinel Blog
cellar-management-software-winery-guide.title: Cellar Management Software: Why Your Winery Should Not Need Two Systems
cellar-management-software-winery-guide.content: If you run a winery that grows its own fruit, you have probably encountered this problem: the software you use in the vineyard does not talk to the software you use in the cellar. This guide covers lot tracking, lab analysis, barrel inventory, and why bundling cellar with vineyard management eliminates data gaps and duplicate costs.

vineyard-work-orders-crew-management.author: Sentinel Blog
vineyard-work-orders-crew-management.title: Vineyard Work Orders: How to Close the Loop Between Scout and Field Crew
vineyard-work-orders-crew-management.content: Vineyard work orders break down when scouting data does not connect to crew execution. Learn how vine-level work orders with auto-updating statuses close the gap between what your scout finds and what your crew does about it.

pesticide-use-reporting-vineyard-complia.author: Sentinel Blog
pesticide-use-reporting-vineyard-complia.title: Pesticide Use Reporting for Vineyards: How to Automate California PUR Compliance
pesticide-use-reporting-vineyard-complia.content: Pesticide use reporting for vineyards is a compliance requirement that consumes hours of admin time each week. Learn how to automate California PUR filings, track REI/PHI intervals, and eliminate spreadsheet reconciliation.

vineyard-replanting-cost-roi-guide.author: Sentinel Blog
vineyard-replanting-cost-roi-guide.title: The Vineyard Replant Decision: When the Data Says Pull, When It Says Wait
vineyard-replanting-cost-roi-guide.content: Vineyard replanting costs $50,000 to $80,000 per acre in Napa Valley when you factor in lost production. Vine-level data turns a gut call into a precise, block-by-block analysis -- and often reveals that a partial replant is the right answer.
